description: Implementation of QpackInstructionDecoder class for decoding QPACK instructions in QUIC protocol, including parsing logic, state management, and error handling.

classes.name: QpackInstructionDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for parsing QPACK instructions in QUIC, managing decoding state, and invoking delegate callbacks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Main decoding loop that processes input data and updates decoder state.

methods.name: AtInstructionBoundary
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is at the start of a new instruction.

methods.name: DoStartInstruction
methods.description: Initializes decoding of a new instruction based on the first byte.

methods.name: DoStartField
methods.description: Prepares to decode the next field of the current instruction.

methods.name: DoReadBit
methods.description: Reads a bit or Huffman encoding flag from data.

methods.name: DoVarintResume
methods.description: Continues decoding a variable-length integer in progress.

methods.name: DoVarintDone
methods.description: Finalizes decoding of a variable-length integer and prepares for next field.

methods.name: DoReadString
methods.description: Reads a string literal from data.

methods.name: DoReadStringDone
methods.description: Completes reading a string, including Huffman decoding if necessary.

methods.name: LookupOpcode
methods.description: Finds the instruction type based on the first byte.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles decoding errors and notifies delegate.
